title: Design System: Concept Store Management System

display.purpose: Public-page statements and rare top-level moments.

headline.purpose: Authentication, workspace, and major task headings.

label.purpose: Form labels and compact action language.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The principal action for a task or form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.8rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.1rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.65rem; color: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); background: var(--primary, #059669); font: 700 0.9rem Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-dark, #047857); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-light, #D1FAE5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A restrained action that must not compete with the primary task.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E8F0); border-radius: 0.6rem; color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); font: 700 0.9rem Inter, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--primary, #059669); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-light, #D1FAE5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: An explicit labeled field for operational data entry.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.45rem; color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); font: 700 0.9rem Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 2.9rem; padding: 0.7rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E8F0); border-radius: 0.6rem; color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); font: 400 1rem Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-light, #D1FAE5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Surface Card
components.description: A flat bordered container for one coherent task or information group.
components.html:
Your organizations

Select the concept store you want to manage.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E8F0); border-radius: 0.75rem; color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; } .ds-card p { margin: 0.75rem 0 0; color: var(--muted, #64748B); line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Count Badge
components.description: Compact quantitative context, never a decorative tag.
components.css: .ds-count-badge { display: inline-block; min-width: 1.75rem; padding: 0.2rem 0.45rem; border-radius: 999px; color: var(--primary-dark, #047857); background: var(--primary-light, #D1FAE5); font: 700 0.75rem Inter, sans-serif; text-align: center; }

components.name: Application Header
components.description: A quiet workspace header that keeps product identity and the session action available.
components.css: .ds-app-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-app-header a { color: inherit; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-app-header button { min-height: 2.6rem; padding: 0.65rem 0.9rem; border: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E8F0); border-radius: 0.6rem; color: inherit; background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); font-weight: 700; } .ds-app-header a:focus-visible, .ds-app-header button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-light, #D1FAE5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Organization Tabs
components.description: A compact local navigation row for sibling organization tasks.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 1.5rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E8F0); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-tabs a { padding: 0 0 0.75rem; color: var(--muted, #64748B); font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none; } .ds-tabs a[aria-current='page'] { border-bottom: 2px solid var(--primary, #059669); color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-light, #D1FAE5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational List Row
components.description: A divided record row with primary identity, supporting metadata, and one quiet action.
components.html:
Makati CentralMKT-01

Ayala Avenue, Makati, Metro Manila, PH
components.css: .ds-list-row { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; padding: 1rem 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--border, #E2E8F0); color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); font-family: Inter, sans-serif; } .ds-list-title { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 0.55rem; } .ds-list-title span { padding: 0.15rem 0.4rem; border-radius: 0.35rem; color: var(--muted, #64748B); background: var(--background, #F8FAFC); font-size: 0.7rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-list-row p { margin: 0.4rem 0 0; color: var(--muted, #64748B); font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; } .ds-list-row button { padding: 0; border: 0; color: var(--primary-dark, #047857); background: transparent; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-list-row button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--primary-light, #D1FAE5); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Success Status
components.description: A textual confirmation for a completed create or update operation.
components.html: Makati Central was updated successfully.
components.css: .ds-success { margin: 0; padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--success, #16A34A); border-radius: 0.5rem; color: var(--foreground, #0F172A); background: var(--surface, #FFFFFF); font: 400 1rem/1.5 Inter, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
The interface should feel like a well-kept operational record: calm enough to support long working sessions, precise enough for inventory and financial workflows, and trustworthy enough for owners and merchants to act without hesitation. Brand expression comes from disciplined hierarchy, crisp emerald actions, and consistent information structure rather than decoration.

The system uses comfortable operational density. It gives forms and decisions enough breathing room to remain legible while avoiding the expansive pacing of a marketing site. Role-specific experiences may change information architecture, but they must remain recognizably part of the same clear system.
keyCharacteristics: Clear hierarchy with comfortable operational density
Emerald actions on neutral slate and white surfaces
Flat structure defined by borders rather than decoration
Consistent patterns optimized for clarity, usability, and speed

rules.name: The Focused Green Rule
rules.body: Operational Emerald identifies actions and meaningful state; most of the interface remains neutral.

rules.name: The Semantic Amber Rule
rules.body: Signal Amber is reserved for warnings and attention, never general decoration.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: Use Inter throughout; hierarchy comes from disciplined scale and weight, not additional font families.

rules.name: The Short-Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Uppercase eyebrows orient the user in a few words and never carry sentences.

rules.name: The Task-Order Rule
rules.body: Responsive layouts collapse in reading and task order; mobile must never require visual position to explain sequence.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: A surface earns elevation through behavior, not importance; static cards remain flat.

rules.name: The Contained-Curve Rule
rules.body: Radii communicate grouping and interaction; avoid oversized, playful rounding on operational surfaces.

dos: Do use solid white surfaces and Hairline Slate borders to organize operational content.
Do reserve Operational Emerald for primary actions and meaningful interactive state.
Do keep form labels explicit, validation messages adjacent, and keyboard focus unmistakable.
Do preserve comfortable density and collapse responsive grids in task order.
Do use plain, direct English appropriate for owners, managers, cashiers, and merchants in the Philippines.
donts: Don't introduce gradients, glassmorphism, translucent panels, or decorative shadows.
Don't add colors, fonts, icon libraries, or interaction patterns without a clear product requirement.
Don't use Signal Amber as decoration or a second brand color.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate status, role, validation, or authorization.
Don't add unnecessary animation to operational workflows.
